findings.evidence: The benefits team coordinates every stipend request from intake to payout.
findings.fix: Rewrite the opening sentence to state the topic the rest of the paragraph covers.
findings.violation: The paragraph's opening sentence shares almost no vocabulary with the rest of the paragraph, so it does not preview the paragraph's actual topic.

findings.evidence: You must keep your equipment in good working condition (line 45) vs Employees keep proof of purchase (line 33) vs You record the stipend item (line 51)
findings.fix: Choose a consistent audience perspective (either 'you' for employees or 'employees/the employee' for impersonal) and apply throughout.
findings.violation: The document shifts between direct address ('you') and impersonal reference ('employees') without distinguishing roles, confusing readers about whom each instruction addresses.

findings.evidence: A separate audit last spring reviewed unrelated travel expenses. Federal guidance on remote work continues to evolve each year. The office coffee budget was reset at the start of the quarter.
findings.fix: Remove sentences unrelated to program coordination or move them to a separate section.
findings.violation: The paragraph includes sentences about travel audits, remote work policy, and office budget that have no connection to stipend program coordination, breaking paragraph unity.

findings.evidence: Section title: 'Terminology Notes'. Content: 'You record the stipend item on the request form. Finance reconciles the reimbursable item against the request log each month. Payroll releases the covered purchase amount after that monthly review.'
findings.fix: Either rename the section to reflect its actual content (e.g., 'Process Steps' or 'Roles and Responsibilities') or add actual term definitions.
findings.violation: The section title promises terminology definitions but the content describes workflow actions, creating a mismatch between heading and content.

findings.evidence: Also, the stipend request, once the manager signs it, after finance confirms the budget line, moves to final processing.
findings.fix: Move the interrupting clause elsewhere, or split it into its own sentence.
findings.violation: 3 comma-set-off clause(s) totalling 14 words intervene between the sentence's apparent subject and its verb.

findings.evidence: An incomplete request pauses the timeline until the missing item arrives. The...
findings.fix: Open the paragraph with a transition word that states its relationship to the prior paragraph.
findings.violation: The paragraph opens with none of the fixed transition words, so the reader is not told how it relates to the paragraph before it.
